hints.title: Capping Contributions
hints.text: Each chosen element can contribute at most the specified threshold value.

hints.title: Greedy Selection
hints.text: Sort the elements in descending order. Cap each value at threshold.

hints.title: Pick Best Elements
hints.text: Take the top elements up to the limit constraint to maximize the overall total sum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting dominates the runtime. Can be reduced to O(n) using quickselect.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Picking arbitrarily or without sorting fails to capture the largest available values.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating a list of capped positive values uses O(n) space for simple greedy selection.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects understanding of greedy choice property after capping.
